text:
Nina: opened a tiny PR to clarify retention language in the audit-export guide and add a minimal Python export snippet: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/712
Omar: Thanks. Legal asked that we avoid definitive phrasing like 'we retain for X' and instead show 'default retention period (for example, 90 days)'.
Nina: Updated to: 'Default retention periods are guidance; enforceable retention is determined by contract, compliance obligations, and applicable law. Dedicated/Private customers may override.'
Leah: Can we add a short Python streaming example and a curl example for updating TTL via admin API? Keep both < 7 lines.
Nina: Added Python streaming sketch:
```py
# streaming export (python)
stream = client.exports.stream(tenant='acme', since='2026-03-01', redact=True)
for chunk in stream:
    process(chunk)
```
Leah: Also add pseudonymization helper and switch JSON sample to `user_ref` instead of `user_id` so examples don't show raw IDs.
Nina: Added:
```
def pseudonymize(rec):
    rec['user_ref'] = hash(rec['user_id'])
    del rec['user_id']
    return rec
```
Legal: LGTM. Small suggestion: replace 'guidance' with 'illustrative guidance' and add note that redaction tools are provided but may not remove every identifier; customers with strict needs should use Dedicated with tenant-level controls.
Nina: Incorporated wording and added brief admin TTL curl example:
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/admin/tenants/acme/retention -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"ttl_days":180}'
docs-bot: link-checker: found 1 broken link in docs/export-playbook.md -> https://internal.company/export-guidelines (404)
Omar: I'll fix that link to https://docs.redwood.com/export-playbook#guidelines and push a commit.
Nina: Thanks. Please add a short note under 'More examples' that shows a paginated CLI command for very large exports.
Omar: Pushed link and CLI snippet: `redwood export --tenant acme --page-size 500 --redact true` in commit 2f9b.
Leah: Quick final read done, formatting nit fixed (```py marker).
Legal: Approved after nit.
Nina: Merged to main after docs CI passed. Closing thread.
docs-bot: deploy-notice: docs.main updated (build 1420) - checks green
